description: What an agent needs to build on a NEAR partner: what it is, its mainnet contract accounts, GitHub, docs and llms.txt, how much of its docs search and semantic_search cover, its NEAR Catalog entry with TVL, and its security incidents. Partners: near-intents (NEAR Intents), intents-agent-api (NEAR Intents Agent API), near-ai-cloud (NEAR AI Cloud), agent-market (NEAR Agent Market), outlayer (NEAR OutLayer), trezu (Trezu), hot (HOT Labs), rhea (Rhea Finance). Also takes a contract account ("intents.near") or a catalog slug.

partner.description: Partner id, name, contract account or catalog slug, e.g. "near-intents".

name: get_partner
